youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用親師會議情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從爸爸走進三年級的 302 教室、在簽到單寫下名字、坐進那張太小的小椅子開始，一路聽陳老師說這學期的上課進度（每早十五分鐘共讀、每週十個新詞、第四單元教圖形和金錢），再問到週四那份數學考卷：六十八分，滿分一百分，全班平均八十二，他低於平均十四分，錯的五題全在應用題。老師又問起在家的夜晚——里奧玩平板到十一點半，功課八點半才寫，早上第一節課眼睛都睜不開。於是大人在學校替他重新安排：平板七點關機、七點半讀二十分鐘、九點準時上床、睡滿十個小時，還約定每天讀二十分鐘、每晚在閱讀紀錄寫一行、老師週一早上畫一顆小星星，十顆星換一次河邊出遊。最後確認下次親師會議是十二月五號星期五下午兩點、成績單週一跟著書包回家、十二月十號有冬季音樂會，爸爸回家後跟太太和里奧把這一切慢慢聊開。全程 800 句，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Parent-Teacher Meeting phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — a father signs the sheet, squeezes into a Grade 3 chair in Room 302, then hears Ms. Chen walk through the term: fifteen minutes of shared reading every morning, ten new words a week, unit four on shapes and money. He asks about Thursday's math quiz: sixty-eight out of one hundred, class average eighty-two, five word problems missed. The teacher asks about nights at home, so the two build a plan: tablet off at seven, twenty minutes of reading at half past seven, lights out at nine, one line in the reading log each night, a small star on Monday, ten stars for a trip to the river. Then the next meeting on Friday, December fifth at two, the report card on Monday, the winter concert on December tenth, and finally the talk at the kitchen table with Leo. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this Room three oh two?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ɪz ðɪs rum θri oʊ tu/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這裡是302教室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you are in the right room.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju ɑr ɪn ðə raɪt rum/
dialogue.zh: 是的，您找對教室了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am Leo's dad, Mr. Lin.
dialogue.zh: 我是里奧的爸爸，我姓林。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, come on in.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mit ju kəm ɑn ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 很高興見到您，請進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I sign the sheet first?
dialogue.zh: 我要先簽到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please write your name in this line.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz raɪt jʊr neɪm ɪn ðɪs laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 請在這一行寫下您的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pen here does not work.
dialogue.zh: 這支筆寫不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use mine, it always writes well.
dialogue.zh: 用我的，它一直很好寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many parents came today?
dialogue.zh: 今天來了幾位家長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nineteen families, all are here now.
dialogue.zh: 十九個家庭，已經到齊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the children at home tonight?
dialogue.zh: 孩子們今晚都在家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this meeting is only for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɪs ˈmitɪŋ ɪz ˈoʊnli fər ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 是的，這場會議只讓家長參加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I sit right now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在應該坐哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any small chair here is free.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的小椅子都是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This little chair was made for kids.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈlɪtəl tʃɛr wʌz meɪd fər kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 這張小椅子是給小孩坐的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please bend your knees and get in.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz bɛnd jʊr niz ənd ɡɛt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 請彎一下膝蓋，坐進去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My knees touch my chin right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ niz tʌtʧ maɪ tʃɪn raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我的膝蓋現在快碰到下巴了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you look very small in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju lʊk ˈvɛri smɔl ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，您坐進去看起來好小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I move it back a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ muv ɪt bæk ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把它往後挪一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will bring a bigger one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ə ˈbɪɡər wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 當然，我去搬一張大一點的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No need, this one will do fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ nid ðɪs wʌn wɪl du faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不用了，這張就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit close, I will speak slowly.
dialogue.zh: 坐近一點，我會說慢一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six o'clock already, are we late?
dialogue.zh: 已經六點了，我們遲到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we start at six thirty.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們六點半才開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Leo's mother coming too?
dialogue.zh: 里奧的媽媽也會來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is at work, so I came alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz æt wɜrk soʊ aɪ keɪmə əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 她在上班，所以我一個人來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is okay, one parent is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz oʊˈkeɪ wʌn ˈpɛrənt ɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，一位家長來就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know you both work long days.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ju boʊθ wɜrk lɔŋ deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我知道你們兩個上班都很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is my card, it has my number.
dialogue.phonetic: /hir ɪz maɪ kɑrd ɪt hæz maɪ ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的名片，上面有我的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I keep these in one folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪ kip ðiz ɪn wʌn ˈfoʊldər/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我都收在同一個資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What will we talk about first?
dialogue.zh: 我們首先要談什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Class news first, then his school work.
dialogue.phonetic: /klæs nuz fɜrst ðɛn hɪz skul wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 先說班上近況，再談他的課業。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a paper with that list?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈpeɪpər wɪð ðæt lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有印著流程的紙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one from the table by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk wʌn frəm ðə ˈteɪbəl baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 請從門口那張桌子拿一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hallway is full of drawings.
dialogue.zh: 走廊上貼滿了畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grade 3 made them all this term.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪd θri meɪd ðɛm ɔl ðɪs tərm/
dialogue.zh: 全是三年級這學期做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did Leo draw the blue boat there?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈlioʊ drɔ ðə blu boʊt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那艘藍色小船是里奧畫的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he painted it in art class.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi ˈpeɪntɪd ɪt ɪn ɑrt klæs/
dialogue.zh: 對，他在美術課畫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will tell him about it tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈtɛl hɪm əˈbaʊt ɪt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚就要告訴他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, he worked hard on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du hi wɜrkt hɑrd ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 請務必，他畫得很用心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the light so low now?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə laɪt soʊ loʊ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在為什麼燈這麼暗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft light keeps the room calm.
dialogue.zh: 柔和的燈讓教室安靜下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone sits in one big circle.
dialogue.zh: 大家都坐在一個大圈圈裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do it so each parent can speak.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ɪt soʊ itʃ ˈpɛrənt kæn spik/
dialogue.zh: 這樣每位家長都方便開口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my seat back there okay?
dialogue.zh: 我坐到後面好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come closer, my voice carries far.
dialogue.zh: 坐近一點，我的聲音傳得遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to wear a name card?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə wɛr ə neɪm kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 我需要別名牌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put on this one, it says Leo's dad.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɑn ðɪs wʌn ɪt sɛz ˈlioʊz dæd/
dialogue.zh: 請戴這個，上面寫著里奧的爸爸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, now I am part of the class.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt naʊ aɪ æm pɑrt əv ðə klæs/
dialogue.zh: 剛好，現在我也是班上的一員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is how we start every year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz haʊ wi stɑrt ˈɛvri jir/
dialogue.zh: 我們每年都是這樣開始的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who helps you with this class?
dialogue.zh: 誰和您搭這個班？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Miss Wu teaches music and art.
dialogue.zh: 吳老師教音樂和美術。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is she also his class teacher?
dialogue.zh: 她也是他的導師嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I am his teacher this year.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ æm hɪz ˈtitʃər ðɪs jir/
dialogue.zh: 不是，這學年我是他的導師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, he talks about you a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd hi tɔks əˈbaʊt ju ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，他常常提到您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He tells funny stories too.
dialogue.zh: 他也會講好笑的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the school day end?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt taɪm dʌz ðə skul deɪ ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 學校每天幾點放學？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three fifteen, and lunch starts at noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈfɪftin ənd lʌntʃ stɑrts æt nun/
dialogue.zh: 三點十五分，午餐從中午開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he walk home alone?
dialogue.zh: 他獨自走回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, an adult must be at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ən əˈdʌlt mʌst bi æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不行，校門口一定要有大人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my wife will pick him up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn maɪ waɪf wɪl pɪk hɪm ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 那我太太會去接他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That works, he stays till four.
dialogue.zh: 那樣剛好，他待到四點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight I want to ask about grades.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt aɪ wɑnt tə æsk əˈbaʊt ɡreɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我想問成績的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I brought his folder, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ brɔt hɪz ˈfoʊldər du nɑt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 我帶了他的檔案夾，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mean the papers in that box?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju min ðə ˈpeɪpərz ɪn ðæt bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 你是說那個盒子裡的作業嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is it, all his work is inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪt ɔl hɪz wɜrk ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 就是它，他所有的作品都在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I look through it at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ lʊk θru ɪt æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶回家慢慢看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it the whole week, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kip ɪt ðə hoʊl wik pliz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，這一整週都留給您看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will bring it back Monday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ɪt bæk ˈmʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我下週一帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday is our report day, too.
dialogue.zh: 週一也是我們發成績單的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His card goes home with him, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz kɑrd goʊz hoʊm wɪð hɪm ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那他的成績單會跟他回家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, sign it and send it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt saɪn ɪt ənd sɛnd ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 對，簽好再讓他帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will read it together at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl rid ɪt təˈɡɛðər æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們會晚上一起看那張單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, and keep your voice soft.
dialogue.zh: 很好，說話語氣輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He knows that I worry too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi noʊz ðæt aɪ ˈwɜri tu mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 他知道我總是擔心太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every parent worries, you are normal.
dialogue.zh: 每位家長都會擔心，您很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we miss the start of it?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi mɪs ðə stɑrt əv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們是不是錯過開場了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, we wait for two more.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt wi weɪt fər tu mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 還沒，我們再等兩位家長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will just listen first.
dialogue.zh: 好，我先專心聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we begin with our class news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi bɪˈɡɪn wɪð ˈaʊər klæs nuz/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就從班上近況開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before that, one quick word.
dialogue.zh: 在那之前，先講一句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, ask me anything now.
dialogue.zh: 當然，您現在儘管問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Leo keeping up in class?
dialogue.zh: 里奧跟得上上課進度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He keeps up well, you will see.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kɛps ʌp wɛl ju wɪl si/
dialogue.zh: 他還跟得上，您等一下會看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I worry most about his math.
dialogue.zh: 我最擔心他的數學。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will talk about that right after.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl tɔk əˈbaʊt ðæt raɪt ˈæftər/
dialogue.zh: 我們等一下就來談這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And he sleeps too little at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd hi slips tu ˈlɪtəl æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 而且他在家都睡得很晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have a note about that in hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə noʊt əˈbaʊt ðæt ɪn hæd/
dialogue.zh: 我手上也有一份相關的紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You wrote it down already?
dialogue.zh: 您已經寫下來了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sleep and school work go together.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs slip ənd skul wɜrk goʊ təˈɡɛðər/
dialogue.zh: 是的，睡眠和課業本來就綁在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now please begin, I am ready.
dialogue.zh: 請開始吧，我準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, let me show you our new wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst lɛt mi ʃoʊ ju ˈaʊər nju wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 首先，讓我給您看我們的新牆面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This chart tracks who reads books.
dialogue.zh: 這張圖記錄誰在讀書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A name moves up when a book ends.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə neɪm muvz ʌp wɛn ə bʊk ɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 讀完一本書，名字就往上移一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is Leo on that list?
dialogue.zh: 他在名單上的哪一處？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Middle of the row, and climbing.
dialogue.zh: 在中間那一排，而且還在往上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me feel much better.
dialogue.zh: 這讓我安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, I will tell you about the term.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ wɪl tɛl ju əˈbaʊt ðə tərm/
dialogue.zh: 現在我先說這學期的進度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are all ears, Ms. Chen.
dialogue.zh: 我們都專心聽，陳老師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you all for coming tonight.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝各位今晚前來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what has the class been doing?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɑt hæz ðə klæs bɪn ˈduɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，班上這學期都在做些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We read together every morning.
dialogue.zh: 我們每天早上一起閱讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is that reading time?
dialogue.zh: 那段閱讀時間有多長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen minutes, right after the bell.
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘，鐘聲一響就開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can Leo read out loud there?
dialogue.zh: 里奧在班上會大聲朗讀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two pages, then the next child.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ˈpeɪdʒɪz ðɛn ðə nɛkst tʃaɪld/
dialogue.zh: 會，讀兩頁就換下一個孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which book is the class using?
dialogue.zh: 班上現在讀的是哪一本書？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A story about a small brown bear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈstɔri əˈbaʊt ə smɔl braʊn bɛr/
dialogue.zh: 一本關於棕色小熊的故事書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it hard for him to read?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt hɑrd fər hɪm tə rid/
dialogue.zh: 這本書對他來說太難嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he knows most words here.
dialogue.zh: 不難，他認得裡面大部分的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else does the day have?
dialogue.zh: 一天還排了什麼課？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Math daily, then science and art.
dialogue.zh: 每天都有數學，然後自然和美術。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you teach in science?
dialogue.zh: 自然課都教些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plants, weather, and how bees work.
dialogue.zh: 植物、天氣，還有蜜蜂怎麼工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did Leo like the plant lesson?
dialogue.zh: 里奧喜歡那堂植物課嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He named his bean plant Sprout.
dialogue.zh: 他還幫自己的豆苗取名小芽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it still live at home?
dialogue.zh: 那盆植物在家裡還活著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two new leaves this week.
dialogue.zh: 活著，這週才長了兩片新葉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is the class pace now?
dialogue.zh: 班上現在的進度怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We finished unit four on Monday.
dialogue.zh: 週一剛教完第四單元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is unit four about numbers?
dialogue.zh: 第四單元是在教數字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is about shapes and money.
dialogue.zh: 它教的是圖形和金錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they raise hands to speak?
dialogue.zh: 他們發言以前會舉手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most do, Leo is one of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst du ˈlioʊ ɪz wʌn əv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 多數會，里奧就是其中一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he answer in full words?
dialogue.zh: 他會用完整的句子回答嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He tries, short answers come fast.
dialogue.zh: 他會試，短句答得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the word wall for?
dialogue.zh: 那面字牆是做什麼用的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New words stay where all can see.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju wɜrdz steɪ wɛr ɔl kæn si/
dialogue.zh: 新學的詞貼在大家看得到的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many words each week?
dialogue.zh: 一週要學幾個新詞？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten words, we test them Friday.
dialogue.zh: 十個詞，星期五小考。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did Leo pass that last test?
dialogue.zh: 那次的拼字小考他及格了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight of ten, he wrote them neat.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt əv tɛn hi roʊt ðɛm nit/
dialogue.zh: 十個對八個，字也寫得整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is his handwriting now?
dialogue.zh: 他的字現在寫得怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better, his letters sit on the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər hɪz ˈlɛtərz sɪt ɑn ðə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 進步了，字母都寫在線上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he need to slow down?
dialogue.zh: 他需要寫慢一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, slow work leaves fewer blanks.
dialogue.zh: 需要，慢慢寫就比較不會留白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the class library?
dialogue.zh: 班上的讀書角情況如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He takes two books home Friday.
dialogue.zh: 他每週五都帶兩本書回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one did he pick last?
dialogue.zh: 他上次挑了哪一本？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A book about trains and tunnels.
dialogue.zh: 一本講火車和隧道書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How fast does he finish books?
dialogue.zh: 他讀書讀得多快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He stops to ask me one word.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi stɑps tə æsk mi wʌn wɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 他會停下來問我一個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he on grade level, then?
dialogue.zh: 那麼他有達到三年級的程度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, reading is his strong side.
dialogue.zh: 有，閱讀是他最強的一項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does he do in a group?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt dʌz hi du ɪn ə ɡrup/
dialogue.zh: 分組活動時他做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He shares glue and cuts the paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ʃɛrz ɡlu ənd kʌts ðə ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 他分享膠棒，還幫著剪紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He waits for his turn, right?
dialogue.zh: 他會乖乖排隊輪流，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most days, two more seconds only.
dialogue.zh: 多數日子只多等兩秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is his spelling this term?
dialogue.zh: 這學期他的拼字怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up from last term, ten new words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp frəm læst tərm tɛn nju wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 比上學期進步，會了十個新詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the dictation part hard?
dialogue.zh: 聽寫那一部分難嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He hears well but writes too slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hiz wɛl bʌt raɪts tu sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 他聽得清楚，但寫得太慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he sit still that long?
dialogue.zh: 他能坐那麼久不動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give him the seat near the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv hɪm ðə sit nir ðə frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 讓他坐靠近前面的那個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he near the word wall?
dialogue.zh: 他坐得離字牆近嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Row two, right beside the poster.
dialogue.zh: 第二排，就在海報旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he ask when he is lost?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi æsk wɛn hi ɪz lɔst/
dialogue.zh: 他不懂的時候會發問嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he raises his hand high.
dialogue.zh: 會，他把手舉得高高的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He talks during the lesson?
dialogue.zh: 上課的時候他會講話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, mostly at the end.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，多半在下課前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a problem for you?
dialogue.zh: 那樣對您來說是問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a quiet tap fixes it.
dialogue.zh: 不是，我輕輕碰他一下就好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much homework each night?
dialogue.zh: 每天晚上有多少功課？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One short sheet, no extra page.
dialogue.zh: 只有一張，不會再加頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it done right after school?
dialogue.zh: 是放學以後馬上寫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He starts after a snack break.
dialogue.zh: 他吃完點心休息才開始寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he need help with words?
dialogue.zh: 他需要人幫他認字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the long ones, then he flies.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə lɔŋ wʌnz ðɛn hi flaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 只有長字需要，之後他就很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does homework take him?
dialogue.zh: 他的功課要花多久時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About ten minutes, not more.
dialogue.zh: 大約十分鐘，不會更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the homework written down somewhere?
dialogue.zh: 功課有寫在聯絡本上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It goes on the board, then home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt goʊz ɑn ðə bɔrd ðɛn hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 會先寫在黑板上，再帶回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he copy it by himself?
dialogue.zh: 他自己抄得下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A friend reads it to him once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə frɛnd ridz ɪt tə hɪm wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 有位同學幫他念一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see his school calendar?
dialogue.zh: 我能看一下學校的行事曆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, week three is full of tests.
dialogue.phonetic: /hir wik θri ɪz fʊl əv tɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 給您，第三週排滿了測驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the big one that week?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪz ðə bɪɡ wʌn ðæt wik/
dialogue.zh: 那一週最重要的測驗是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The reading check, on Wednesday.
dialogue.zh: 是週三的閱讀評量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we practice at home for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ˈpræktɪs æt hoʊm fər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們在家要替他練習嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just read a book and talk about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst rid ə bʊk ənd tɔk əˈbaʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只要讀書，再聊一聊內容。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Talk in English or in Chinese?
dialogue.zh: 用英文講還是用中文講？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chinese is fine, ideas matter most.
dialogue.zh: 中文也可以，想法最重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is he best at in class?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪz hi bɛst æt ɪn klæs/
dialogue.zh: 他在班上最擅長什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is great at helping others.
dialogue.zh: 他很會幫別人的忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That comes from our dinner table.
dialogue.zh: 那是從我們家飯桌學來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good habits follow him here.
dialogue.zh: 好習慣也跟到他這裡來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And what still needs work?
dialogue.zh: 那他還有什麼要加強？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reading questions, he guesses fast.
dialogue.zh: 閱讀題他答太快，常在猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whole page wrong, or just lines?
dialogue.zh: 整頁都錯，還是只錯幾行？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One or two lines, not the page.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɔr tu laɪnz nɑt ðə peɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 只錯一兩行，不至於整頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does the class do this year?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dʌz ðə klæs du ðɪs jir/
dialogue.zh: 這學年班上整體表現如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong, and calmer than last year.
dialogue.zh: 很強，也比去年安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is everyone at the same place?
dialogue.zh: 大家的程度都落在同一處嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most are near, three need more time.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ɑr nir θri nid mɔr taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 多數接近，有三位要多些時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Leo one of those three?
dialogue.zh: 里奧是那三位裡面的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he is steady, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hi ɪz ˈstɛdi du nɑt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 不是，他很穩，請別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, that helps a lot.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這樣我明白多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, about math and that Thursday quiz.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ əˈbaʊt mæθ ənd ðæt ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ kwɪz/
dialogue.zh: 接下來談數學和週四那份考卷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that is my second question.
dialogue.zh: 對，那正是我的第二個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us open his math folder now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ˈoʊpən hɪz mæθ ˈfoʊldər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在打開他的數學資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the quiz from Thursday?
dialogue.zh: 這就是週四那份數學考卷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sixty-eight of one hundred.
dialogue.zh: 是的，滿分一百分，他拿六十八。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty-eight, that is new to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti æt ðæt ɪz nju tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 六十八分，這件事我是頭一回知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It came home in his bag Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt keɪm hoʊm ɪn hɪz bæɡ ˈfraɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那份考卷週五跟著書包回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he say nothing at home?
dialogue.zh: 他在家裡什麼都沒說嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, he hid it under his clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hi hɪd ɪt ˈʌndər hɪz kloʊðz/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，他把它塞在衣服下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the class average here?
dialogue.zh: 這份考卷全班平均多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighty-two, so he is below it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪti tu soʊ hi ɪz bɪˈloʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 八十二分，所以他低於平均。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far below is that, then?
dialogue.zh: 那他比平均落後多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen points, not a big gap.
dialogue.zh: 十四分，不算太大的差距。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did he lose the most?
dialogue.zh: 他主要在哪一類題目失分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Word problems, he missed five.
dialogue.zh: 應用題，他錯了五題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those the long questions?
dialogue.zh: 是那些寫得很長的題目嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three lines and one question.
dialogue.zh: 對，三行故事只問一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He reads them too fast?
dialogue.zh: 他是不是讀題讀太快了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He stops at the first number.
dialogue.zh: 他都停在第一個數字那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So he counts before he thinks?
dialogue.zh: 所以他還沒想完就開始算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, he circles and then writes.
dialogue.zh: 對，他畫了圈就往下寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he read the words there?
dialogue.zh: 那些題目裡的詞他看得懂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Words like left, share, and more.
dialogue.zh: 像剩下、分給、還有多少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should he learn those words?
dialogue.zh: 這些詞他要先背起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We say them daily in class.
dialogue.zh: 我們班上每天都會念這些詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did he get right, then?
dialogue.zh: 那他有答對哪些部分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All the subtraction rows.
dialogue.zh: 減法那幾排他全對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the hardest part.
dialogue.zh: 那才是最難的一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, his numbers work fast here.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，他在這裡算得又快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are shapes okay with him?
dialogue.zh: 圖形那一塊他還好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, unit four paid off.
dialogue.zh: 全對，第四單元沒白學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the money part at the end?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈmʌni pɑrt æt ði ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 最後那個金錢題呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He gave the right change, once.
dialogue.zh: 有一次他找零算對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has he used coins at home?
dialogue.zh: 他在家用過硬幣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, we only pay by phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt wi ˈoʊnli peɪ baɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 還不會，我們都用手機付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the store can be his class.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðən ðə stɔr kæn bi hɪz klæs/
dialogue.zh: 那超商可以變成他的教室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, give him coins and a list.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡɪv hɪm kɔɪnz ənd ə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 好，給他硬幣和一張購物單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many problems should he do?
dialogue.zh: 他一天該練幾題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five a day, no more than five.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ə deɪ noʊ mɔr ðæn faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 一天五題，不要超過五題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will a retake fix the score?
dialogue.zh: 重考一次能把分數救回來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do not retake quizzes here.
dialogue.zh: 我們這裡不安排重考。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then what can move it up?
dialogue.zh: 那什麼辦法能讓它上升？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short practice, twice a week.
dialogue.zh: 短短的練習，一週兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you send that practice home?
dialogue.zh: 那些練習可以讓帶回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will put two sheets in his bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pʊt tu ʃits ɪn hɪz bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我會在他書包裡放兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will you look at them?
dialogue.zh: 您什麼時候看那些練習？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuesday morning, with my coffee.
dialogue.zh: 週二早上，我配著咖啡看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he get extra help here?
dialogue.zh: 他在學校會得到特別的幫忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes with a small group.
dialogue.zh: 跟一小組同學練十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that group on school days?
dialogue.zh: 那一組是排在上課的日子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Wednesday after lunch.
dialogue.zh: 對，排在週三午餐後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he miss his art for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl hi mɪs hɪz ɑrt fər ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 他會因此缺了美術課嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it stays inside his class time.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt steɪz ɪnˈsaɪd hɪz klæs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 不會，就排在班級時間裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else is in that group?
dialogue.zh: 還有誰也在那一組？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three children, all kind ones.
dialogue.zh: 三個孩子，個性都很和氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there one who is good at math?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr wʌn hu ɪz ɡʊd æt mæθ/
dialogue.zh: 其中有數學很好的孩子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one boy helps without noise.
dialogue.zh: 有個男孩會安靜地幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So Leo asks him for help?
dialogue.zh: 里奧會去請他幫忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, after he tries first.
dialogue.zh: 有時候，在他先自己試過以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about his number writing?
dialogue.zh: 他寫數字的樣子如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He turns six into a zero.
dialogue.zh: 他常把六寫成一個零。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can that change the answer?
dialogue.zh: 那樣會影響答案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A lot, twenty becomes ninety.
dialogue.zh: 影響很大，二十變成九十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he check his own work?
dialogue.zh: 他會檢查自己寫的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can count back with adding.
dialogue.zh: 他可以用加法倒著驗算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he do that on tests?
dialogue.zh: 考試的時候他也這樣做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, he likes to finish first.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt hi laɪks tə ˈfɪnɪʃ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 還不會，他總想第一個寫完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How slow should he go, then?
dialogue.zh: 那他的速度該多慢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One finger under each line.
dialogue.zh: 用手指壓著一行一行讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that taught in your class?
dialogue.zh: 這個方法你們班上有教嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we call it the slow finger.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi kɔl ɪt ðə sloʊ ˈfɪŋɡər/
dialogue.zh: 有，我們把它叫做慢手指。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will use that word at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl juz ðæt wɜrd æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我在家也會用這個說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, same words help him most.
dialogue.zh: 麻煩了，同樣的用詞對他最有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What score do we hope for next?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt skɔr du wi hoʊp fɔr nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 下一次我們希望看到幾分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seventy-five shows real growth.
dialogue.zh: 七十五分就是真的進步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is the next math quiz?
dialogue.zh: 下一場數學小考在什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In three weeks, on a Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 三週以後，也是星期四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it have word problems too?
dialogue.zh: 那次也會有應用題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, four of them, one page.
dialogue.zh: 會有，四題，一頁而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to bring the quiz?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə brɪŋ ðə kwɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我要把這份考卷帶來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep it at the desk at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kip ɪt æt ðə dɛsk æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 不用，留在家裡的書桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then he sees it every day?
dialogue.zh: 那他每天都會看到它？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let him post it by his bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt hɪm poʊst ɪt baɪ hɪz bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 讓他把它貼在床邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A number on the wall, okay.
dialogue.zh: 牆上一個數字，好吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows him that he moves up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoʊz hɪm ðæt hi muvz ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 那會讓他看見自己往上走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the report carry this score?
dialogue.zh: 成績單會把這個分數寫上去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it writes every subject line.
dialogue.zh: 會，每一科那一列都寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will sign it on Monday night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl saɪn ɪt ɑn ˈmʌndeɪ naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我週一晚上就簽那張單子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, that tells him you care.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðæt tɛlz hɪm ju kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，這讓他知道您在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His mother will want to see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz ˈmʌðər wɪl wɑnt tə si ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他媽媽也會想看一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can talk by phone that day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn tɔk baɪ foʊn ðæt deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那天我們可以打電話細談。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we have three weeks to work.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi hæv θri wikz tə wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 所以還有三週可以努力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough time, if his nights are calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf taɪm ɪf hɪz naɪts ɑr kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 只要夜晚穩定，時間就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mean sleep and quiet time.
dialogue.zh: 您說的是睡眠和安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is exactly what I mean.
dialogue.zh: 我指的正是這兩樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I push him or wait?
dialogue.zh: 我該催他還是在旁邊等？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit beside him, do not sit over him.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt bəˈsaɪd hɪm du nɑt sɪt ˈoʊvər hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 坐在他旁邊，不要壓著他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is my hard part, truly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，那正是我難的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are doing it right now.
dialogue.zh: 您現在這樣做就已經對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing still bothers me.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事讓我在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name it, we have time tonight.
dialogue.zh: 您直說，今晚還有時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think poor sleep hurt that score.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk pʊr slip hɜrt ðæt skɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我覺得是沒睡好壞了那分數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us talk about his nights now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs tɔk əˈbaʊt hɪz naɪts naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在來談他的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do his evenings look?
dialogue.zh: 他的晚上都是怎麼過的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To be honest, they end too late.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bɪ ˈɑnɪst ðeɪ ɛnd tu leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，都結束得太晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does he go to bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt taɪm dʌz hi ɡoʊ tə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 他幾點才上床睡覺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half past eleven, most nights.
dialogue.zh: 多半是十一點半才躺下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven thirty? That is very late.
dialogue.zh: 十一點半？那真的太晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, school starts at eight.
dialogue.zh: 我知道，學校八點就要上課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So he gets five hours of sleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hi ɡɛts faɪv ˈaʊərz əv slip/
dialogue.zh: 那他就只睡五個小時？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five and a half, maybe less.
dialogue.zh: 五個半小時，也許還少一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Children his age need ten hours.
dialogue.zh: 他這個年齡的孩子要睡十小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is where we fail.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，就是在這裡我們沒做好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What keeps him up so late?
dialogue.zh: 是什麼讓他撐到那麼晚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A game on his tablet, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡeɪm ɑn hɪz ˈtæblət aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我想是平板上的那個遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He plays it after dinner?
dialogue.zh: 他都在吃完晚飯以後玩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says just one more round.
dialogue.zh: 他總說再玩一局就停下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And one round becomes four.
dialogue.zh: 結果一局就變成四局。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Until eleven, then a quick bath.
dialogue.zh: 玩到十一點，才匆匆洗澡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tablet sleeps with him, right?
dialogue.zh: 那台平板也陪他一起上床嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, under his blanket, always.
dialogue.zh: 是的，永遠在他的毯子底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That light hurts his eyes.
dialogue.zh: 那種光線對他的眼睛不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It also keeps his brain awake.
dialogue.zh: 也會讓他的腦子睡不著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep it then?
dialogue.zh: 那你們平常把它收在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the kitchen shelf, by the cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ʃɛlf baɪ ðə kʌps/
dialogue.zh: 在廚房的架子上，杯子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He can reach that shelf, yes.
dialogue.zh: 他踮腳就夠得到，是啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then move it to your room tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn muv ɪt tə jʊr rum təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就今晚搬到您的房間去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is homework also done that late?
dialogue.zh: 功課也拖到那麼晚才寫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it starts at eight thirty.
dialogue.zh: 對，都八點半才開始動筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does it start so late?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要拖到那麼晚才寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get home at eight from work.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɛt hoʊm æt eɪt frəm wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 我上班八點才回到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So dinner waits for me there.
dialogue.zh: 所以晚飯要等我到家才吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the whole night runs late.
dialogue.zh: 於是整個晚上都跟著延後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can homework start before dinner?
dialogue.zh: 功課能不能在吃飯前先寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best change, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst tʃeɪndʒ aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我覺得這是最該改的一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should his mother know all this?
dialogue.zh: 他媽媽也該知道這些嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we talk about it often.
dialogue.zh: 知道，我們常常討論這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She works nights on Wednesdays.
dialogue.zh: 她每週三都要上夜班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That makes the evening harder.
dialogue.zh: 那讓那個晚上更難安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you two get enough sleep?
dialogue.zh: 那你們兩個睡得夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not enough, but that is our part.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɪˈnʌf bʌt ðæt ɪz ˈaʊər pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 不夠，但那是我們大人的功課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He takes after us, then.
dialogue.zh: 所以他是跟著我們學的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Children copy what they see.
dialogue.zh: 孩子就是在模仿他們看見的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he tired in the first class?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hi ˈtaɪərd ɪn ðə fɜrst klæs/
dialogue.zh: 第一節課他是不是很睏？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His eyes close during the reading.
dialogue.zh: 大家一起朗讀時他的眼就閉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He puts his head down, then?
dialogue.zh: 他會把頭趴到桌上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice on the desk, on Monday.
dialogue.zh: 週一有兩次趴著不肯抬頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you do when that happens?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt du ju du wɛn ðæt ˈhæpənz/
dialogue.zh: 那種時候您都會怎麼做？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hand him a cup of cold water.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hænd hɪm ə kʌp əv koʊld ˈwɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 我遞給他一整杯冷水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would that help him wake up?
dialogue.zh: 那樣能讓他清醒一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, for ten minutes only.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，但只撐十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it show in his quiz score?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt ʃoʊ ɪn hɪz kwɪz skɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那有沒有反映在他的分數上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last page, he left it blank.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst peɪdʒ hi lɛft ɪt blæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 最後那一頁他整頁留白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was he too sleepy then?
dialogue.zh: 那時候他是太睏了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think so, his time ran out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk soʊ hɪz taɪm ræn aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我想是，他的時間不夠用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is slow in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 他早晨總是慢吞吞的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He forgets his bag at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi fərˈɡɛts hɪz bæɡ æt ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 他常在門口忘了自己的袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does he eat breakfast?
dialogue.zh: 他的早餐都怎麼吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half a toast, standing up.
dialogue.zh: 站著吃半片吐司就出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then his body has no fuel.
dialogue.zh: 那他的身體就沒有力氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, math needs a full tank.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，上數學最需要有體力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long can he work there?
dialogue.zh: 他在課堂上能專心多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen sharp minutes, then drifting.
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘很專心，之後就飄走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you help us set a time?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hɛlp ʌs sɛt ə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我們定一個時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bed at nine, every single night.
dialogue.zh: 每天晚上一律九點上床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine o'clock, that is a big change.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn əˈklɑk ðæt ɪz ə bɪɡ tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 九點整，那是很大的改變。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start tomorrow, not next month.
dialogue.zh: 從明天開始，別拖到下個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the tablet go off first?
dialogue.zh: 是不是該先把平板關掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off at seven, out of the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf æt ˈsɛvən aʊt əv ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 七點關機，再拿出房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we read for twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 接下來我們讀二十分鐘書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven thirty, that fits nicely.
dialogue.zh: 七點半開始，那個時段剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And lights out by nine sharp.
dialogue.zh: 然後九點準時關燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That gives him ten hours of sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡɪvz hɪm tɛn ˈaʊərz əv slip/
dialogue.zh: 那樣他就睡滿十個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten hours, that is our goal.
dialogue.zh: 十個小時，那就是我們的目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on the fridge, so he sees.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt ɑn ðə frɪdʒ soʊ hi siz/
dialogue.zh: 寫在冰箱上，讓他天天看見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weekends count the same way?
dialogue.zh: 週末也要守同樣的規則嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same hour, or Monday is hard.
dialogue.zh: 時間要一樣，否則週一會辛苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A warm bath before bed, yes?
dialogue.zh: 睡覺前先泡個熱水澡，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and dim the lamp, too.
dialogue.zh: 可以，也把檯燈調暗一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we keep his door open?
dialogue.zh: 他的房門要留開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed is calmer, with a small light.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd ɪz ˈkɑmər wɪð ə smɔl laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 關著更安靜，留一盞小夜燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He likes a story at night.
dialogue.zh: 他喜歡晚上聽一篇故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read him one, then turn off.
dialogue.zh: 念一篇給他聽，接著關燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know, I never saw this.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我從沒看出這一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most parents hear it first here.
dialogue.zh: 多數家長都是先在這裡聽見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I thought late nights were normal.
dialogue.zh: 我以為孩子睡得晚是常態。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many do it, few talk about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛni du ɪt fju tɔk əˈbaʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很多人這樣過，很少有人談它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I failing him as a father?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ ˈfeɪlɪŋ hɪm əz ə ˈfɑðər/
dialogue.zh: 是我這個爸爸沒做好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you are fixing it tonight.
dialogue.zh: 不是，您今晚就已經在改了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I felt blamed, just now, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我剛剛以為被責備。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never blame here, we are one team.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər bleɪm hir wi ɑr wʌn tim/
dialogue.zh: 這裡不怪任何人，我們是同一隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One team, I like that word.
dialogue.zh: 同一隊，我喜歡這個說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He hears it too, at home and here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hɪrz ɪt tu æt hoʊm ənd hir/
dialogue.zh: 他也聽得懂，在家在學校都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you watch him in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju wɑtʃ hɪm ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 早上的時候您可以留意他嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will note if his eyes are tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl noʊt ɪf hɪz aɪz ɑr ˈtaɪərd/
dialogue.zh: 我會記下他的眼睛是否睏倦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will I see that note?
dialogue.zh: 那我要怎麼看到您的紀錄？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line in his planner, Fridays.
dialogue.zh: 每週五在他的聯絡本寫一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will check that planner nightly.
dialogue.zh: 我會每晚打開那個聯絡本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, that closes the circle.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝您，這樣就前後連起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, first the sleep, then the reading.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ fɜrst ðə slip ðɛn ðə ˈridɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 所以先穩睡眠，再談閱讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And reading needs a daily start.
dialogue.zh: 而閱讀要有每天固定的開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then please tell me that plan.
dialogue.zh: 那就請您告訴我那個計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us fix twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們先把二十分鐘定下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, how is he with others?
dialogue.zh: 那他和別人相處得怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very well, that is my short answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri wɛl ðæt ɪz maɪ ʃɔrt ˈænsər/
dialogue.zh: 很好，這就是我的簡短回答。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who sits next to him?
dialogue.zh: 他旁邊坐的是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A boy named Sam, since September.
dialogue.zh: 一個叫山姆的男孩，從九月起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the two boys get along?
dialogue.zh: 他們兩個男孩合得來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They share one pencil box daily.
dialogue.zh: 他們每天共用同一個筆盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Sam helping him in math?
dialogue.zh: 山姆會在數學上幫他嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he is in the small group.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi ɪz ɪn ðə smɔl ɡrup/
dialogue.zh: 會，他也在那個小小組裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a girl he plays with?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ɡɜrl hi pleɪz wɪð/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有他常一起玩的女生？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mia, they run the tag game.
dialogue.zh: 米亞，他們兩個玩抓人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is faster between them?
dialogue.zh: 他們兩個人誰比較快？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mia is quick, Leo plans his runs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmiə ɪz kwɪk ˈlioʊ plænz hɪz rʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 米亞快，里奧會先想路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does he like recess time?
dialogue.zh: 他喜歡課間活動的時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is his best part of the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz hɪz bɛst pɑrt əv ðə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那是一天裡他最棒的時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they go out with the class?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ ɡoʊ aʊt wɪð ðə klæs/
dialogue.zh: 他們跟全班一起下樓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in two lines, then run free.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪn tu laɪnz ðɛn rʌn fri/
dialogue.zh: 對，排兩列出門再自由跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does he wait for friends?
dialogue.zh: 他都在哪裡等他的朋友？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, at the bottom of the stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz æt ðə ˈbɑtəm əv ðə stɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 一定在樓梯底下等他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has he ever come inside alone?
dialogue.zh: 他會不會自己一個人先回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, when his ball went far.
dialogue.zh: 只有一次，因為他的球跑遠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the boys ever fight?
dialogue.zh: 男孩之間會打架嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not once this term, thank goodness.
dialogue.zh: 這學期一次也沒有，謝天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they argue over the rules?
dialogue.zh: 他們會為了規則爭執嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, then they pick again.
dialogue.zh: 會爭一點，然後重新選過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who gives in first there?
dialogue.zh: 在遊戲裡誰先讓步？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leo says sorry before two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 里奧不到兩分鐘就先說抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a hard skill, truly.
dialogue.zh: 那真的是很難的本領。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We practice it in our circle time.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈpræktɪs ɪt ɪn ˈaʊər ˈsɜrkəl taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我們在圈圈時間裡練習這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will he join the new children?
dialogue.zh: 他會主動跟新來的孩子玩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a new boy joined last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə nju bɔɪ dʒɔɪnd læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 有，上週才來了一個新男孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did Leo do for him?
dialogue.zh: 里奧為那個孩子做了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He showed where the shoes go.
dialogue.zh: 他帶那孩子去換鞋的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any talk with the quiet ones?
dialogue.zh: 他跟安靜的孩子有來往嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He sits with one at lunch time.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɪts wɪð wʌn æt lʌntʃ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 吃午餐時他會陪其中一位坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why that one, did he say?
dialogue.zh: 他有說為什麼是那一位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He said she had no one there.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛd ʃi hæd noʊ wʌn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 他說那個女生身邊沒有同伴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that surprise you?
dialogue.zh: 那樣讓您意外嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It made my whole week, I am honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt meɪd maɪ hoʊl wik aɪ æm ˈɑnɪst/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，那讓我一週都很暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he a leader in the group?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hi ə ˈlidər ɪn ðə ɡrup/
dialogue.zh: 他在同學裡面是帶頭的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He leads games, not the class.
dialogue.zh: 他帶的是遊戲，不是班級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he sharing his things?
dialogue.zh: 他會分享自己的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snacks and pens, both he shares.
dialogue.zh: 點心和筆，他兩樣都分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Has he taken things from others?
dialogue.zh: 他會不會隨手拿別人的東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two times, we fixed it with words.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈtaɪmz wi fɪkst ɪt wɪð wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 有兩次，我們用說話處理好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does he handle losing?
dialogue.zh: 他輸了的時候會怎麼反應？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He frowns, then he asks to play again.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi fraʊnz ðɛn hi æsks tə pleɪ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 他先皺眉，再要求玩一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he ever sad at school?
dialogue.zh: 他在學校會不開心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, and only in the washroom.
dialogue.zh: 只有一次，而且是在洗手間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did someone hurt him there?
dialogue.zh: 有人在那裡讓他難受嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A joke, he thought it was true.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dʒoʊk hi θɔt ɪt wʌz tru/
dialogue.zh: 一個玩笑，他卻以為是真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you say to him?
dialogue.zh: 您當時對他說了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I said most jokes are for fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛd moʊst dʒoʊks ɑr fər fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我說多數玩笑都只是為了好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he take that to heart?
dialogue.zh: 那句話他聽進去了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he laughed at it next day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hi læft æt ɪt nɛkst deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 聽進去了，隔天他還拿它開玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the children read his score?
dialogue.zh: 同學們會看他的分數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Papers face down, that is our rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpərz feɪs daʊn ðæt ɪz ˈaʊər rul/
dialogue.zh: 考卷一律朝下放，這是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So nobody teased him about it?
dialogue.zh: 所以沒有人取笑他那件事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, Sam only asked about his game.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ sæm ˈoʊnli æskt əˈbaʊt hɪz ɡeɪm/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，山姆只問他玩的遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He talks at the wrong time?
dialogue.zh: 他會在不對的時機說話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, mostly when my back is turned.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈmoʊstli wɛn maɪ bæk ɪz tərnd/
dialogue.zh: 會，多半在我背對著他們時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you do then with him?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt du ju du ðɛn wɪð hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那種時候您怎麼處理他？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I say his name, once, softly.
dialogue.zh: 我只輕輕地叫他的名字一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And that stops the talking?
dialogue.zh: 那樣能讓他停止講話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stops one line, then he is back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑps wʌn laɪn ðɛn hi ɪz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 能安靜一句，接著他又開口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he too loud in the room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hi tu laʊd ɪn ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 他在教室裡音量大過頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At games yes, in reading no.
dialogue.zh: 玩遊戲時會，讀書時不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who helps clean up after?
dialogue.zh: 活動結束後誰幫忙收拾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He returns the scissors and glue.
dialogue.zh: 他會把剪刀和膠棒放回盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is he on activity days?
dialogue.zh: 學校辦活動的那天他如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He waits for his turn in line.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi weɪts fər hɪz tərn ɪn laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 他會排隊等輪到自己。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he win those races?
dialogue.zh: 那些競賽他贏過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He runs for fun, not for medals.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi rʌnz fər fʌn nɑt fər ˈmɛdəlz/
dialogue.zh: 他跑是因為好玩，不是為獎牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any friends invited to your home?
dialogue.zh: 有同學被邀請到家裡來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam asked, we said after the term.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm æskt wi sɛd ˈæftər ðə tərm/
dialogue.zh: 山姆問過，我說這學期以後再約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will Sam come if we invite?
dialogue.zh: 如果我們請，山姆會來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask his mother by a short note.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪz ˈmʌðər baɪ ə ʃɔrt noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 寫一張短字條請他媽媽就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one good friend for him?
dialogue.zh: 他有一個交情很好的朋友嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He has three, and one is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hæz θri ənd wʌn ɪz ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 他有三個，其中一位很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is the quiet one there?
dialogue.zh: 那一位安靜的是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new boy, he listens first.
dialogue.zh: 是新來的男孩，他先聽再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he stand up for friends?
dialogue.zh: 他會替朋友說話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He told a big kid to stop once.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi toʊld ə bɪɡ kɪd tə stɑp wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 有一次他叫年長的孩子住手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that a risky thing?
dialogue.zh: 那樣會不會有危險？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I praised it, then we talked safety.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ preɪzd ɪt ðɛn wi tɔkt ˈseɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 我先稱讚他，再跟他談安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they work well in pairs?
dialogue.zh: 兩人一組時他們配合得好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pairs are how they learn to talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɛrz ɑr haʊ ðeɪ lɜrn tə tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 兩人配對正是在練習說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he listen to other ideas?
dialogue.zh: 他會聽別人的想法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He nods first, then adds his own.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi nɑdz fɜrst ðɛn ædz hɪz oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 他先點頭，再加進自己的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do girls and boys mix there?
dialogue.zh: 班上男生女生玩得到一起嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly yes, tag needs both sides.
dialogue.zh: 大致可以，抓人遊戲需要兩邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is he with grown-ups?
dialogue.zh: 他跟大人相處起來怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says hello, and means it.
dialogue.zh: 他會問好，而且是真心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you give him a class job?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju ɡɪv hɪm ə klæs dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 您會交給他一件班上的差事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He feeds the fish, since October.
dialogue.zh: 從十月起他就負責餵魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that fish have a name?
dialogue.zh: 那班魚有名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Sprout, after his bean plant.
dialogue.zh: 有，叫小芽，跟他的豆苗同名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You remember that, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 您還記得那件事，謝謝您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep notes on small things too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip noʊts ɑn smɔl θɪŋz tu/
dialogue.zh: 這些小事我也都記在筆記上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, friends are not his worry.
dialogue.zh: 所以人際關係不是他的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, now let us build his reading.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ naʊ lɛt ʌs bɪld hɪz ˈridɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不是，現在我們來搭他的閱讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, twenty minutes of reading daily?
dialogue.zh: 所以每天讀書二十分鐘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is all I want from home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɔl aɪ wɑnt frəm hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 我對家裡的要求只有這一項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every day, even on weekends?
dialogue.zh: 每天都要讀，連週末也算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, weekends are good long days.
dialogue.zh: 對，週末時間長，最適合讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What counts as reading, exactly?
dialogue.zh: 什麼內容才算在閱讀？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any book, even a comic page.
dialogue.zh: 任何書都可以，連漫畫一頁也算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do comics really help him?
dialogue.zh: 漫畫真的對他有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They build speed, then we move on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ bɪld spid ðɛn wi muv ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 它們先練速度，之後再換別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which level books should we buy?
dialogue.zh: 我們該買哪一級的書？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy none, the class box is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ nʌn ðə klæs bɑks ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 不用買，班上的書箱免費借。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many books come in the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni bʊks kʌm ɪn ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 那個書箱裡面有幾本書？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve readers, all Grade 3 level.
dialogue.zh: 十二本，都是三年級的程度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he keep one for a week?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn hi kip wʌn fər ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 他可以留一本在家一週嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One at a time, back on Fridays.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn æt ə taɪm bæk ɑn ˈfraɪˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 一次一本，週五帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a long book better for him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə lɔŋ bʊk ˈbɛtər fər hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 讀長一點的書對他比較好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short ones, finished, beat long ones.
dialogue.zh: 讀完的短書，勝過沒讀完的長書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if he stops after five?
dialogue.zh: 如果他讀五分鐘就停呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read five, and write five down.
dialogue.zh: 那就讀五分，也照實記五分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then how do we reach twenty?
dialogue.zh: 那我們要怎麼湊滿二十分鐘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two small blocks of ten, that works.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu smɔl blɑks əv tɛn ðæt wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 分成兩段各十分鐘，就行得通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sit with him when he reads?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ sɪt wɪð hɪm wɛn hi ridz/
dialogue.zh: 他讀書的時候我要陪坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes with you is best.
dialogue.zh: 有您陪著讀十分鐘最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I read the English to him?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rid ði ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ tə hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我可以用英文念給他聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, your voice is his model.
dialogue.zh: 請這樣做，您的聲音是他的示範。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we take turns reading lines?
dialogue.zh: 我們輪流一行一行念嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, page for page, that is fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈpeɪdʒ fər ˈpeɪdʒ ðæt ɪz fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好，一頁換一頁，這樣好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if he does not want to read?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf hi dʌz nɑt wɑnt tə rid/
dialogue.zh: 如果他不願意讀怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose the book together first.
dialogue.zh: 先一起挑要讀的那一本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should he read out loud always?
dialogue.zh: 他每一回都要大聲朗讀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half aloud, half with his eyes.
dialogue.zh: 一半大聲念，一半用眼睛看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I correct every wrong word?
dialogue.zh: 每個讀錯的詞我都要糾正嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only two per page, keep moving.
dialogue.zh: 一頁只糾兩個，繼續往下讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which quiet place works best?
dialogue.zh: 哪個安靜的地方最合適？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the window, that small one.
dialogue.zh: 就在窗邊，那張小桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Television off, that is clear.
dialogue.zh: 電視要關掉，這一點很明確。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very clear, sound breaks reading.
dialogue.zh: 很清楚，聲音會打斷閱讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about music in his room?
dialogue.zh: 他那間房間可以放音樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft music is fine, no words.
dialogue.zh: 輕音樂可以，但不要有歌詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I know which books?
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼知道要挑哪幾本？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will email you a short list.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈimel ju ə ʃɔrt lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 我會用電子郵件寄一張書單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is that list, roughly?
dialogue.zh: 那張書單大約有幾本？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten titles, easy to find here.
dialogue.zh: 十本書名，在我們這裡都借得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get one book home tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi ɡɛt wʌn bʊk hoʊm təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚能先帶一本書回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put it in his bag now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pʊt ɪt ɪn hɪz bæɡ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，現在就放進他的書包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one will he like most?
dialogue.zh: 他會最喜歡裡面哪一本？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The train book, he asked for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪn bʊk hi æskt fər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那本火車的書，他自己要過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I read the whole book to him?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ rid ðə hoʊl bʊk tə hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我要整本念給他聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the first three pages.
dialogue.zh: 先念前面三頁就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should he tell me what happened?
dialogue.zh: 讀完他要把內容講給我聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask one question, then let him talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk wʌn ˈkwɛsʧən ðɛn lɛt hɪm tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 問一個問題，然後讓他說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if his answer is wrong?
dialogue.zh: 如果他答的內容是錯的呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say, let us look again together.
dialogue.zh: 就說我們再一起回頭看一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he pick the same book twice?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn hi pɪk ðə seɪm bʊk twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 同一本書他能讀兩遍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, repeat builds his speed.
dialogue.zh: 請讓他再讀一遍，重複練速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would a story count as reading?
dialogue.zh: 一篇故事也算在閱讀裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, even one page from a paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈivɪn wʌn peɪdʒ frəm ə ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 算，就算是報紙上的一頁也算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I give him a harder word?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɪv hɪm ə ˈhɑrdər wɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 我要另外教他較難的詞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hard word a day is plenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hɑrd wɜrd ə deɪ ɪz ˈplɛnti/
dialogue.zh: 一天一個難詞就很足夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does he write that word?
dialogue.zh: 那個詞他要寫在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In his small notebook, three times.
dialogue.zh: 寫在他的小筆記本上，寫三次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, about that nightly log.
dialogue.zh: 再來是那份每晚的紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line each night: title, minutes.
dialogue.zh: 每晚記一行：書名和分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who signs that log, me or him?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu saɪnz ðæt lɔɡ mi ɔr hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那份紀錄是我簽還是他簽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sign, he writes the title.
dialogue.zh: 您簽名，他把書名寫上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you do with that log?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt du ju du wɪð ðæt lɔɡ/
dialogue.zh: 您會怎麼處理那份紀錄？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I read it Monday morning, quickly.
dialogue.zh: 我週一早上會快速看過一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you write something back?
dialogue.zh: 您會在上面回寫一些字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small star, that is my way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl stɑr ðæt ɪz maɪ weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我會幫他畫一顆小星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A star makes him show it off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stɑr meɪks hɪm ʃoʊ ɪt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 有一顆星，他就願意給別人看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he brings the book to school.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hi brɪŋz ðə bʊk tə skul/
dialogue.zh: 然後他會把那本書帶到學校。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many stars mean a prize?
dialogue.zh: 湊幾顆星算得到一個獎勵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten stars, then a weekend outing.
dialogue.zh: 十顆星，換一次週末外出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An outing to the river, good.
dialogue.zh: 到河邊走走，那個提議很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it down, he will work hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt daʊn hi wɪl wɜrk hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 把這件事寫下來，他會努力湊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I keep the log at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kip ðə lɔɡ æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 那份紀錄我要留在家裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lives in his bag every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt livz ɪn hɪz bæɡ ˈɛvri deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 它每天都在他的書包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if we miss a night, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf wi mɪs ə naɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 要是我們漏掉了一晚怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Draw a blank, then start again.
dialogue.zh: 那一格就留白，然後重新開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No scolding for a missed day?
dialogue.zh: 漏掉一天不能罵他是嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never use reading as a punishment.
dialogue.zh: 千萬別把讀書當作處罰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, reading first, then a bath.
dialogue.zh: 所以先讀書，再來洗澡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any order, keep seven thirty.
dialogue.zh: 順序都可以，守住七點半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven thirty, twenty minutes, bed at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈθɜrti ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts bɛd æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 七點半、二十分鐘、九點上床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You just said our whole plan.
dialogue.zh: 您剛剛把整個計畫講完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the tablet stays in the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈtæblət steɪz ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 而那台平板就留在廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then his eyes can rest at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hɪz aɪz kæn rɛst æt eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這樣他八點時眼睛能休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If he reads well, what next?
dialogue.zh: 如果他讀得穩定，接下來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In two weeks we add five more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn tu wiks wi æd faɪv mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 兩週之後我們再加五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty-five, that is still short.
dialogue.zh: 二十五分鐘，說起來還是很短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short daily beats long sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 每天短讀勝過偶爾長讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who signs it on weekends?
dialogue.zh: 週末的時候誰來簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His mother, she keeps the habit.
dialogue.zh: 他媽媽簽，她會守住這習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will take the earlier bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl teɪk ði ˈɜrliər bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 那我改搭早一班的公車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That puts you home by seven fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pʊts ju hoʊm baɪ ˈsɛvən ˈfɪftin/
dialogue.zh: 那樣您七點十五分就到家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I can sign the log myself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ kæn saɪn ðə lɔɡ maɪˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 那樣我就能自己簽那份紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why I asked about nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ aɪ æskt əˈbaʊt naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我為什麼要問他的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks, then we speak again.
dialogue.zh: 兩週以後我們再談一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send me one line by phone, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd mi wʌn laɪn baɪ foʊn pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請用手機傳一行訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, twenty minutes start tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 說定了，二十分鐘從明天開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, and then every day.
dialogue.zh: 明天開始，然後天天都讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do we meet again like this?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn du wi mit əˈɡɛn laɪk ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我們下次什麼時候再這樣見面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday, December fifth, at two.
dialogue.zh: 十二月五號星期五，下午兩點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: December fifth, is that this year?
dialogue.zh: 十二月五號，就是今年的對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this year, same room here.
dialogue.zh: 對，就在今年，還是這間教室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At two in the afternoon, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就是下午兩點開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the school lets parents leave early.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə skul lɛts ˈpɛrənts liv ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 對，這個時段方便家長提早離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it on a normal school day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ɑn ə ˈnɔrməl skul deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那一天是正常上學日嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, children have short classes.
dialogue.zh: 是的，孩子那天只上短課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will Leo be there with me?
dialogue.zh: 里奧那天會跟我們在一起嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He joins us for ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 他會進來跟我們待十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What will he show to us there?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt wɪl hi ʃoʊ tə ʌs ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 他在那裡會給我們看什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His best paper and his reading log.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz bɛst ˈpeɪpər ənd hɪz ˈridɪŋ lɔɡ/
dialogue.zh: 他最好的作業和閱讀紀錄本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I bring that log again?
dialogue.zh: 那個紀錄本我要再帶過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I keep it in my drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ kip ɪt ɪn maɪ drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 不用，我會收在我的抽屜裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many minutes for each family?
dialogue.zh: 每一組家長有幾分鐘？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen, then the next family.
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘，然後換下一家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I book a time before two?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ bʊk ə taɪm bɪˈfɔr tu/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在兩點以前預約時段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign the list at the door, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪn ðə lɪst æt ðə dɔr pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請先在門口那份名單上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that list online or on paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt lɪst ˈɑnˌlaɪn ɔr ɑn ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 那份名單是網路的還是紙本的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper, like tonight, by the door.
dialogue.zh: 紙本的，就像今晚一樣放門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my wife be there too?
dialogue.zh: 我太太也會到場嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both parents are welcome there.
dialogue.zh: 兩位家長都歡迎過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She can leave work at one thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kæn liv wɜrk æt wʌn ˈθɜrti/
dialogue.zh: 她那天一點半就能下班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she can sign in at two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi kæn saɪn ɪn æt tu/
dialogue.zh: 那她兩點可以在門口簽到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we write our questions down?
dialogue.zh: 我們要先把問題寫下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one page keeps us on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn peɪdʒ kips ʌs ɑn taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 要，寫在一頁上才不會超時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should that page carry?
dialogue.zh: 那一頁要寫哪幾件事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His sleep, his reading, his math.
dialogue.zh: 他的睡眠、他的閱讀、他的數學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I show the log to my wife?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ʃoʊ ðə lɔɡ tə maɪ waɪf/
dialogue.zh: 那份紀錄我也要給太太看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show it, she signs the weekends.
dialogue.zh: 給她看，週末都是她簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask one thing by mail?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk wʌn θɪŋ baɪ meɪl/
dialogue.zh: 我能先用郵件問一件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I answer on the same day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ ˈænsər ɑn ðə seɪm deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，我當天就會回信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is your email again?
dialogue.zh: 您的電子郵件地址是？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is printed on the sheet by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈprɪntɪd ɑn ðə ʃit baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 就印在門口那張紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I call you at school?
dialogue.zh: 我能在學校打電話給您嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call before four, I am free then.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl bɪˈfɔr fɔr aɪ æm fri ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 四點以前打，那個時段我有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the school office open late?
dialogue.zh: 學校的行政處晚上也開門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It closes at five, sharp.
dialogue.zh: 它五點整就關門了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I book that call ahead?
dialogue.zh: 那通電話要事先預約嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a short call is always fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ə ʃɔrt kɔl ɪz ˈɔlweɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，簡短的電話隨時都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If he is sick, who do I call?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf hi ɪz sɪk hu du aɪ kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 如果他生病，我要打給誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The office, before eight thirty.
dialogue.zh: 打給行政處，八點半以前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if he is hurt at school?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf hi ɪz hɜrt æt skul/
dialogue.zh: 那如果他在學校受傷了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We call you right away, first.
dialogue.zh: 我們會立刻先打電話給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else sees those notes?
dialogue.zh: 還有誰會看到那些紀錄？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the grade team, and you.
dialogue.zh: 只有三年段的老師，還有您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the principal in on this?
dialogue.zh: 校長也會知道這些狀況嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He only sees the big picture.
dialogue.zh: 校長只留意整體的狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you share news with other teachers?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ʃɛr nuz wɪð ˈʌðər ˈtitʃərz/
dialogue.zh: 您會把狀況告訴其他老師嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in one meeting each month.
dialogue.zh: 會，每個月一次年級教師會議。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the report card come?
dialogue.zh: 成績單什麼時候發？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday, it goes home with him.
dialogue.zh: 週一發，會跟著他一起回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we sign that card as well?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi saɪn ðæt kɑrd əz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 那張成績單我們也要簽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign at the bottom, date it too.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪn æt ðə ˈbɑtəm deɪt ɪt tu/
dialogue.zh: 在底下簽名，還要寫日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the next term start?
dialogue.zh: 下一學期什麼時候開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In January, the tenth day.
dialogue.zh: 在一月，十號那天開學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the winter break two weeks long?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɪntər breɪk tu wiks lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 寒假有兩週那麼長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks, and no homework then.
dialogue.zh: 兩週，那段時間沒有功課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we stop the reading in break?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi stɑp ðə ˈridɪŋ ɪn breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 那寒假期間要暫停閱讀嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep five minutes, do not stop all.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip faɪv ˈmɪnɪts du nɑt stɑp ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 保留五分鐘就好，別全停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else is coming this month?
dialogue.zh: 這個月還有別的活動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The winter concert, on December tenth.
dialogue.zh: 冬季音樂會，在十二月十號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do children sing on that night?
dialogue.zh: 孩子們那天晚上要唱歌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Grade 3 has two short songs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡreɪd θri hæz tu ʃɔrt sɔŋz/
dialogue.zh: 要唱，三年段有兩首短歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we buy a seat for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi baɪ ə sit fər ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 我們要為那場買位子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free seats, just come early.
dialogue.zh: 座位免費，早一點來就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
