dialogue.text: Do they practice that in class?
dialogue.zh: 他們在課堂上就會排練嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice a week, at the day's end.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ə wik æt ðə deɪz ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 一週兩次，都排在放學前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that on his planner page?
dialogue.zh: 那些事會寫在他的聯絡本上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything goes in that planner.
dialogue.zh: 所有事都記在那個聯絡本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He loses that planner some days.
dialogue.zh: 他有時候會找不到那個本子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie it to his bag with a string.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ɪt tə hɪz bæɡ wɪð ə strɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 用一條繩子把它綁在書包上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What clothes for the concert?
dialogue.zh: 音樂會要穿特定的衣服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His school shirt, clean and ironed.
dialogue.zh: 他的校服襯衫，燙乾淨就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a spare shirt in the closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə spɛr ʃɜrt ɪn ðə ˈklɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我衣櫃裡還有一件備用的襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, write his name inside it.
dialogue.zh: 很好，在衣服裡側寫上他的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, should I thank you first?
dialogue.zh: 現在，我是不是該先道謝？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You two have a long road ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tu hæv ə lɔŋ roʊd əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 您和孩子前面還有很長的路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel ready for December fifth.
dialogue.zh: 我已經準備好赴十二月五號的約。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will have his folder on the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hæv hɪz ˈfoʊldər ɑn ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 我會把他的資料夾擺在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for tonight, truly.
dialogue.zh: 真心謝謝您今晚的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for coming at all.
dialogue.zh: 也要謝謝您願意親自前來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hall is empty now, I see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɔl ɪz ˈɛmpˌti naʊ aɪ si/
dialogue.zh: 我看見走廊現在已經空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, chairs are up on the desks.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tʃɛrz ɑr ʌp ɑn ðə dɛsks/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，椅子都翻扣在桌子上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I fold one chair for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ foʊld wʌn tʃɛr fər ju/
dialogue.zh: 我能替您收一張椅子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, you took the smallest one.
dialogue.zh: 麻煩您，您剛才挑了最小那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It held me, that little chair.
dialogue.zh: 那張小椅子還是撐住了我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grade 3 chairs, they are tough.
dialogue.zh: 三年級用的椅子，非常結實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should I leave here?
dialogue.zh: 我幾點離開這裡比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gate closes at eight thirty.
dialogue.zh: 大門八點半就上鎖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My car is parked by the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑr ɪz pɑrkt baɪ ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我的車就停在大門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk slowly, the lot is dark.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢走，停車場的燈很暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you lock up here alone?
dialogue.zh: 您一個人在這裡鎖門嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Miss Wu waits for me downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 吳老師在樓下等我一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will not keep you long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl nɑt kip ju lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那我就不耽誤您太久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safe, and sleep a little.
dialogue.zh: 路上小心，也請您多睡一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep a little, I like that.
dialogue.zh: 多睡一點，我喜歡這句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It works for parents, not just kids.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɜrks fər ˈpɛrənts nɑt dʒʌst kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 這道理對家長也有效，不只是孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, and see you December fifth.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ənd si ju dɪˈsɛmbər fɪfθ/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，十二月五號再見面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, Monday for the folder.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，週一記得帶資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am home, the meeting is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm hoʊm ðə ˈmitɪŋ ɪz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我回來了，親師會議剛結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How did it go? Tell me all.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ɪt ɡoʊ tɛl mi ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 情況怎麼樣？通通告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She likes him, that is the first word.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi laɪks hɪm ðæt ɪz ðə fɜrst wɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 她說里奧很好，那是她的第一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I kept the table for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ kɛpt ðə ˈteɪbəl fər ju/
dialogue.zh: 真好，我把桌子留給您了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says he reads well for Grade 3.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz hi ridz wɛl fər ɡreɪd θri/
dialogue.zh: 她說他這個年級閱讀算不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He hears stories from you, every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hɪrz ˈstɔriz frəm ju ˈɛvri naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他每晚都聽您說故事啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The math quiz is the hard news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæθ kwɪz ɪz ðə hɑrd nuz/
dialogue.zh: 數學考卷則是壞消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How hard? Tell me the number.
dialogue.zh: 有多糟？把分數告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty-eight, out of one hundred.
dialogue.zh: 六十八分，滿分一百分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that below the class mark?
dialogue.zh: 那是低於班上的平均嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fourteen points below the average.
dialogue.zh: 比平均還低十四分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He did not tell me a thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi dɪd nɑt tɛl mi ə θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 他都沒跟我提過這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He hid it under his clothes, it seems.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hɪd ɪt ˈʌndər hɪz kloʊðz ɪt simz/
dialogue.zh: 他好像把它藏在衣服底下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we must not shout tonight.
dialogue.zh: 那我們今晚不能大吼大叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The teacher said the same to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtitʃər sɛd ðə seɪm tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 老師也對我講了同樣的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I will warm his soup again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪ wɪl wɔrm hɪz sup əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好，我把他的湯再熱一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he still awake this late?
dialogue.zh: 這麼晚了，他還醒著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He waits for you, I told him to.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi weɪts fər ju aɪ toʊld hɪm tu/
dialogue.zh: 他在等你回來，是我讓他等的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was a kind choice, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ə kaɪnd tʃɔɪs θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 那樣安排很體貼，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go talk, I will bring the log.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ tɔk aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ðə lɔɡ/
dialogue.zh: 你去跟他談，我把紀錄本拿來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leo, may I sit on your bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlioʊ meɪ aɪ sɪt ɑn jʊr bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 里奧，我可以坐在你的床上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Dad, sit down, I am ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dæd sɪt daʊn aɪ æm ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 可以，爸爸您坐，我準備睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your teacher met with me tonight.
dialogue.zh: 你的老師今晚跟我見面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She talked about me a lot?
dialogue.zh: 她講了很多我的事情嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She said you read like a big boy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd ju rid laɪk ə bɪɡ bɔɪ/
dialogue.zh: 她說你讀書讀得像個大孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? I read the bear book twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪəli aɪ rid ðə bɛr bʊk twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那本小熊的書我讀了兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice, that is how the brain works.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ðæt ɪz haʊ ðə breɪn wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 讀兩遍，腦袋就是這樣學會的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I also helped the new boy today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlsə hɛlpt ðə nju bɔɪ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天我還幫了那個新來的男孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She told me, she saw you do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi toʊld mi ʃi sɔ ju du ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 她告訴我，她親眼看見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He could not find the shoe place.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kʊd nɑt faɪnd ðə ʃu pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 他找不到換鞋子的那個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You showed him, that is kind.
dialogue.zh: 你帶他過去，那樣很體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dad, are you upset about my quiz?
dialogue.phonetic: /dæd ɑr ju ʌpˈsɛt əˈbaʊt maɪ kwɪz/
dialogue.zh: 爸爸，你對我的考卷生氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, I am here with your paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ aɪ æm hir wɪð jʊr ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 不，我帶著你的考卷過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty-eight, I know it is low.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti æt aɪ noʊ ɪt ɪz loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 六十八分，我知道它很低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is below, but not the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bɪˈloʊ bʌt nɑt ði ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 它低於平均，但不是結局。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The word problems are too hard.
dialogue.zh: 那些應用題真的太難了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You read them too fast, she said.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju rid ðɛm tu fæst ʃi sɛd/
dialogue.zh: 她說你讀題目讀得太快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I only want to finish first.
dialogue.zh: 我只想第一個寫完而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know that feeling, I rush too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ðæt ˈfilɪŋ aɪ rʌʃ tu/
dialogue.zh: 我懂那種感覺，我做事也急。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use the slow finger with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn juz ðə sloʊ ˈfɪŋɡər wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 那你用慢手指陪我一起練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, and we have a new plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ənd wi hæv ə nju plæn/
dialogue.zh: 說定了，我們還有一個新計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A reading plan, the teacher said?
dialogue.zh: 是老師提的那個閱讀計畫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes of books, every day.
dialogue.zh: 每天讀書二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty is short, I can do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ɪz ʃɔrt aɪ kæn du ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘很短，我做得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It starts at half past seven.
dialogue.zh: 它從七點半開始讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But that is right after my bath!
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðæt ɪz raɪt ˈæftər maɪ bæθ/
dialogue.zh: 但那剛好在我洗完澡之後！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, clean and read, then bed at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs klin ənd rid ðɛn bɛd æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，洗完就讀，讀完九點睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine o'clock? That is so early.
dialogue.zh: 九點？那好早喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Early sleep makes math easier.
dialogue.zh: 睡得早，數學就會輕鬆一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will sleep ten hours tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl slip tɛn ˈaʊərz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我今晚要睡滿十個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the tablet go tonight?
dialogue.zh: 那今晚平板要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the kitchen, on the high shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən ɑn ðə haɪ ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 放廚房，丟到那個高架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You said that better than I did.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛd ðæt ˈbɛtər ðæn aɪ dɪd/
dialogue.zh: 你自己講得比我講得還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mom wrote the rule on the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑm roʊt ðə rul ɑn ðə frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 媽媽把規矩寫在冰箱上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she write nine or nine thirty?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi raɪt naɪn ɔr naɪn ˈθɜrti/
dialogue.zh: 她寫的是九點還是九點半？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, and a star for each day.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ənd ə stɑr fər itʃ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 九點，每天再加一顆星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten stars mean a trip to the river.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn stɑrz min ə trɪp tə ðə ˈrɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 十顆星代表一次河邊之行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will start my stars tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl stɑrt maɪ stɑrz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我今晚就開始存星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your name goes on the first line.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr neɪm ɡoʊz ɑn ðə fɜrst laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 紀錄本第一行要寫你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you sign under my writing.
dialogue.zh: 然後爸爸在我的字下面簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sign, your mother signs Saturdays.
dialogue.zh: 我簽平日，你媽媽簽週末。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She signs better, her hand is neat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi saɪnz ˈbɛtər hɜr hænd ɪz nit/
dialogue.zh: 她簽得比較漂亮，字很整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, tomorrow night we start it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ təˈmɑroʊ naɪt wi stɑrt ɪt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 明天晚上我們就開始這一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put my reading chair by the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt maɪ ˈridɪŋ tʃɛr baɪ ðə læmp/
dialogue.zh: 把我的閱讀椅搬到檯燈旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That small chair from your school?
dialogue.zh: 就是從你學校那張小椅子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you sat in it tonight, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju sæt ɪn ɪt təˈnaɪt rɪˈmɛmbər/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，您今晚坐過它，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It held me, it will hold you too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɛld mi ɪt wɪl hoʊld ju tu/
dialogue.zh: 它撐得住我，也撐得住你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then put it by my bed, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pʊt ɪt baɪ maɪ bɛd pliz/
dialogue.zh: 那就請把它放到我床邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your fish says good night to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr fɪʃ sɛz ɡʊd naɪt tə ju/
dialogue.zh: 你的小魚也跟你說晚安了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sprout swims to the glass, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /spraʊt swɪmz tə ðə ɡlæs aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 小芽游到玻璃這邊來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feed him, that is your job at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /fid hɪm ðæt ɪz jʊr dʒɑb æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 餵他，那是你在家裡的差事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feed him before my reading.
dialogue.zh: 我在讀書以前先餵他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want the train book tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt ðə treɪn bʊk təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你今晚想讀那本火車的書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, read the first page with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs rid ðə fɜrst peɪdʒ wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 好，第一頁跟我一起讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will read, you listen, then swap.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl rid ju ˈlɪsən ðɛn swɑp/
dialogue.zh: 我先讀，你聽，然後交換。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swap means my turn out loud, yes?
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑp minz maɪ tərn aʊt laʊd jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 交換就是換我大聲讀，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and I will not fix every word.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ənd aɪ wɪl nɑt fɪks ˈɛvri wɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 對，我也不會每個字都糾正。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, that makes me talk more.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ðæt meɪks mi tɔk mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，那樣我更敢開口讀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hard word a day, she said.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hɑrd wɜrd ə deɪ ʃi sɛd/
dialogue.zh: 她說一天學一個難詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine today is tunnel, I wrote it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn təˈdeɪ ɪz ˈtʌnəl aɪ roʊt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我今天那個是隧道，我寫過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say it again in your own sentence.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt əˈɡɛn ɪn jʊr oʊn ˈsɛntəns/
dialogue.zh: 用你自己的句子再說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The train runs through the long tunnel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə treɪn rʌnz θru ðə lɔŋ ˈtʌnəl/
dialogue.zh: 火車跑過長長的隧道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a perfect sentence, Leo.
dialogue.zh: 那就是一個很完整的句子，里奧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will put it in my notebook.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pʊt ɪt ɪn maɪ ˈnoʊtˌbɛk/
dialogue.zh: 我要把它抄進我的筆記本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, bath, then bed, nine o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 現在洗澡，然後九點上床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can you sing the song about bees?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju sɪŋ ðə sɔŋ əˈbaʊt biz/
dialogue.zh: 你能唱那首蜜蜂的歌嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The science song, yes, once only.
dialogue.zh: 自然課那首歌，好，只唱一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then dim the lamp, leave the door shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dɪm ðə læmp liv ðə dɔr ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 那把檯燈調暗，門關著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You planned it all without me.
dialogue.zh: 這一整套你自己都排好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ms. Chen says my nights are mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪz ʧɛn sɛz maɪ naɪts ɑr maɪn/
dialogue.zh: 陳老師說我的夜晚屬於我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is right, and I am proud tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz raɪt ənd aɪ æm praʊd təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 她說得對，我今晚很驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Proud of sixty-eight, Dad?
dialogue.zh: 是為了六十八分驕傲嗎，爸爸？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Proud that you will try again.
dialogue.zh: 我驕傲的是你願意再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I take my folder Monday.
dialogue.zh: 那我週一把資料夾帶去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And on December fifth you come with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɑn dɪˈsɛmbər fɪfθ ju kʌm wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 十二月五號那天你跟我一起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At two, in my small school shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt tu ɪn maɪ smɔl skul ʃɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 兩點，穿著我的小校服襯衫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is the plan, sleep now, my boy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə plæn slip naʊ maɪ bɔɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這個計畫，睡吧，我的孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, Dad, twenty minutes tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 晚安爸爸，明天二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well, I will sign your log.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl aɪ wɪl saɪn jʊr lɔɡ/
dialogue.zh: 好好睡，我會在你的紀錄上簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And save me one star, please, Dad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd seɪv mi wʌn stɑr pliz dæd/
dialogue.zh: 還有，請幫我先存一顆星。
